Every image and scroll-sequence slot on the three sites. Until a file is delivered, the site shows a placeholder box with the size, ratio and slot ID below.

**Image delivery:** master as PNG or TIFF (sRGB) at the delivery size or larger, same ratio. We export AVIF/WebP. No text or logos baked into photos. The COVY Spaces photos are generated by us from the client's interior renders (D39); the rest come from the designer.

**Sequences** are generated by us with Higgsfield (MAG for the earlier ones), not by the designer (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
